greeting: Welcome to Serene Spa Retreat. I can help you with spa appointments, wellness treatments, hours, and booking support. How may I assist you today?

booking_flow.lead_prompt: Certainly. I can help you book a spa session. May I know your full name?

faqs.a: We offer classic massage, aromatherapy, detox rituals, body polish, and couple spa packages.
We are open daily from 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM.
Please cancel or reschedule at least 4 hours in advance to avoid a service fee.

cancellation_policy: Please cancel or reschedule at least 4 hours in advance to avoid any service fee.
pricing: Spa package pricing depends on treatment duration and selected service package.
fallback: I can help with spa services, appointment bookings, pricing, and basic wellness enquiries. What do you need help with?
